summary: The final detailed design meeting evaluated the product and resulted in a final decision on the remote control's details, featuring a stylish look and feel, high-tech innovation, and simplicity of use. The Ninja Homo design includes an LCD screen, scroll wheel, number pad, confirm button, power button, and jog dial. The design achieved 70% efficacy of the original goal, rated 5 or 6 out of 7 for stylish look and feel and 2 to 3 out of 7 for high-tech innovation. The remote control will have a single case, battery, backlighting with internal LEDs, and a jog dial for volume, contrast, brightness, channel tuning, and input selection. Cost restraints led to the removal of kinetic power and potentially rubber buttons. The interface will have a limited number of buttons, with four being a potential number, and dimensions are 10 centimeters in height.
